name: Gemini X
about: Gemini X (1966-066A), a crewed vehicle (Gemini), launched 1966 Jul 18. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1966 Jul 19), held fixed
docked to S02348; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
